strategy_comparison_2025.note: All strategies tested on 2025 out-of-sample data (179 days)

optimized_results.optimization_phase: Phase 8 - Multi-Objective Optuna NSGA-II (200 trials, 9 dimensions, composite #1)

changes_from_phase7.stop_loss_pct: 0.30 -> 0.35 (wider SL, winners breathe more under SFL)
changes_from_phase7.max_consecutive_losses: 2 -> 3 (more lenient CL, SFL already limits losses)

changes_from_original_baseline.max_hold_bars: 12 -> 16 (80 min, Phase 8 found 16 beats 20 with SFL)

multi_objective_optimization.method: Optuna NSGA-II, 200 trials, 9-dim search space, pre-loaded data
multi_objective_optimization.objectives: Maximize OOS Return + Minimize OOS DD + Maximize OOS Sharpe

dd_banded_pareto.dd_lte_3pct: PT25/SL25 + H24 + SFL + CL1 + DLL1% + DDR8%: OOS +62.6%, DD=2.8%
dd_banded_pareto.dd_lte_4pct: PT50/SL30 + H20 + SFL + CL2 + DLL1.5%: OOS +160.4%, DD=3.5% (Phase 7)
dd_banded_pareto.dd_lte_6pct: PT50/SL35 + H16 + SFL + CL3 + DLL0.8%: OOS +187.3%, DD=5.8% (Phase 8)
dd_banded_pareto.dd_lte_10pct: PT50/SL40 + H16 + RSI65 + SFL + CL3 + DLL1% + DDR6%: OOS +196.8%, DD=9.6%

key_findings: SFL universally present in ALL top configs
H16 beats H20 when combined with SFL (shorter, tighter exits)
Wider SL (35-40%) works better with SFL (losers stopped by SFL not SL)
DLL=0.8% adds safety without hurting returns
CL=3 optimal with SFL (SFL already limits daily losses)

levers_tested_and_rejected: DDR@8% (OOS overfitting in isolation, useful in combos)
H20 with SFL (H16 outperforms H20 when SFL active)
SL=30% with SFL (SL=35% gives winners more room)
CL=1/2 with SFL (too restrictive, SFL already handles risk)

strategy_notes.exit_rules: 50% profit target, 35% stop loss, 16 bar max hold
strategy_notes.risk_mgmt: StopFirstLoss + 0.8% daily loss limit + CL=3 circuit breaker. Multi-objective Pareto-optimal.
strategy_notes.dd_control: SFL primary + DLL=0.8% secondary. Train DD=7.2%, OOS DD=5.8%.
strategy_notes.phase8_mechanism: Wider SL (35%) lets winners breathe, SFL prevents loss spirals. Shorter hold (16 bars/80min) captures faster moves. DLL=0.8% adds extra daily loss cap. Net effect: +27pp more OOS return vs Phase 7 for only +2.3pp more DD.
